answer_result.answer: Dave's main passion is working on cars—especially auto engineering, car restoration, and transforming/restoring classic cars.

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models.
[S26T5] (dia_id: D26:5)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It's always been my thing. My dad took me to my first car show when I was 10, and I was wow-ed! I was hooked and wanted to learn more. Now I'm an automotive engineer and it's crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts.
[S26T6] (dia_id: D26:6)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music. Check this out - a pic of me performing with someone I admire! So amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a dj in a nightclub with a dj table]
[S26T7] (dia_id: D26:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?
[S26T8] (dia_id: D26:8)

Calvin: It was unreal, Dave. Being up there with someone I admire - it was a dream come true. The energy, the crowd - it made me realize how much music means to me, it's like my passion and my purpose.
[S26T9] (dia_id: D26:9)

Dave: That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us.
[S26T10] (dia_id: D26:10)

Calvin: Definitely, Dave. It's awesome to find something that makes us happy. It's fulfilling and motivating too. I'm so glad we're on this journey together and curious to see what happens next!
[S26T11] (dia_id: D26:11)

Dave: Me too, Calvin! Let's see where it takes us. We can keep inspiring each other!
[S26T12] (dia_id: D26:12)

Calvin: Yep, let's keep inspiring each other to be our best selves. Keep going for your passion, buddy.
[S26T13] (dia_id: D26:13)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Same to you! Keep pursuing your passion and keep dreaming. We got this! Got to go see you soon!
[S26T14] (dia_id: D26:14)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I appreciate your support. Let's keep pushing for our goals. Catch you later, see ya!
[S26T15] (dia_id: D26:15)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin (answering whether it's satisfying to see his hard work pay off, on the restoration finished that day — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) that "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-10-04, said he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful, and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (said to Calvin right after Calvin praised his grease-stained hands — "Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!" — context in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) [S21T10].
- On 2023-10-08, when telling Calvin about his car show and restored/modified car (details in ## Classic cars), said working on cars "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — it's "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress"; as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage, tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" (echoing his childhood memories of working on cars with his dad, see above); now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" [S22T5].
- On 2023-10-08, said doing what he loves has been "my goal since I was a kid" and it's awesome that he's able to do it; restoring things can be tough but "the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great"; Calvin responded that bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," that working on cars "can be a real escape from reality" (he understands the feeling), and that "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal," adding "Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7].
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own; he finds that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed (conversation flow in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships; Calvin's response in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7].

Calvin: He's been such a great friend to me. Always there to support and encourage me. His positivity has made a big difference in my journey.
[S29T5] (dia_id: D29:5)

Dave: It's great how someone's support and encouragement can really shape our lives! They give us the motivation to keep going and trust ourselves. Do you also find having supportive people around you important for your artist development?
[S29T6] (dia_id: D29:6)

Calvin: Having supportive people is key for me to grow as an artist. They motivate me to get better and stay true to myself. Having support is vital, especially in this tough music industry. Take a look at this photo!
[Image caption: a photography of a group of people sitting around a desk]
[S29T7] (dia_id: D29:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Is this a pic of some musicians you're collaborating with?
[S29T8] (dia_id: D29:8)

Calvin: Yeah, I've been supporting some young musicians from a music program. Supporting their passion is amazing and their enthusiasm is inspiring.
[S29T9] (dia_id: D29:9)

Dave: Wow, Calvin, that's amazing! You're really making a difference by supporting the next generation of musicians. It's great to nurture their passion and help them thrive.
[S29T10] (dia_id: D29:10)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! It's like a torch being passed to keep music alive! These young musicians are very ambitious, I think I will support them for a long time.	
[S29T11] (dia_id: D29:11)

Dave: Yeah, Calvin! Your support for them keeps the music going and passes on the legacy. That's so awesome!
[S29T12] (dia_id: D29:12)

Calvin: I'm stoked I made a difference. Paying it forward, ya know? Working with new talent brings new ideas to this. Look at this photo, here's how I'm making a beat for a young artist, he has great potential in music! 
[Image caption: a photo of a man sitting at a desk in front of a computer]
[S29T13] (dia_id: D29:13)

Dave: Wow, that's cool! Your music studio looks great. Have you tried out any new ideas lately?
[S29T14] (dia_id: D29:14)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-05-31, said working on cars is "definitely therapeutic" and that it is not difficult for him to help neighbors with their cars [S7T4].
- Passionate about fixing up things in general: "more than just a hobby" — it gives him a sense of achievement and purpose [S7T6].
- Gets "a real buzz" transforming something that's not working into something that runs smoothly — "like giving it a second chance" [S7T6].
- Giving something a new life "makes [him] feel powerful and happy — like [he] really achieved something"; he agreed with Calvin that they both "take something and make it look amazing" [S7T7][S7T8].

Dave: Hey Calvin, long time no see! A lot's been happening since we last talked. Guess what? I finally opened my own car maintenance shop! It's so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars - it's like a dream come true! Take a look at the photo.
[Image caption: a photo of a car dealership with cars parked in front of it]
[S4T1] (dia_id: D4:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave! Congrats on opening your own car maintenance shop! It looks like all your hard work and dedication paid off.
[Image caption: a photo of a man standing under a car in a garage]
[S4T2] (dia_id: D4:2)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! It's great to see my hard work paying off. Opening this shop was my dream, and I'm really happy to see it getting started. It was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it.
[S4T3] (dia_id: D4:3)

Calvin: Woo, Dave! Congrats on achieving your dream - you've got guts and ambition - that's awesome! Keep it up!
[Image caption: a photo of a book with a space theme on it]
[S4T4] (dia_id: D4:4)

Dave: Thanks! Appreciate the support. My dream was to open a shop and it's a step towards my other dream of working on classic cars. I love their design and engineering.
[S4T5] (dia_id: D4:5)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! Going for it with classic cars is cool! Fulfilling your dreams is so important.
[Image caption: a photo of a red car parked in a parking lot]
[S4T6] (dia_id: D4:6)

Dave: I'm obsessed with classic cars. They have a unique charm. I was so thrilled to restore one last year—nothing like bringing it back to life! Take a look at the engine of the restored car.
[Image caption: a photo of a car engine with a small air filter]
[S4T7] (dia_id: D4:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave! That looks awesome!
[S4T8] (dia_id: D4:8)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! It was a labor of love. Challenging, but so worth it.
[S4T9] (dia_id: D4:9)

Calvin: Yeah, it's awesome when you see something you worked on come to life.
[S4T10] (dia_id: D4:10)

evidence_items.section: # Dave > ## Hobbies and sense of purpose
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-10-23, told Calvin (who asked what the toughest part of car restoration is) that it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off — echoing his earlier remarks that small details make his mod project unique and personalized (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)) and that the small successes make him proud (see above) [S25T18][S25T19].
- On 2023-10-25, said working on a car project "takes me out of my head and calms me down" — complementing his long-stated "oasis of calm"/therapy remarks above [S26T4].
- As of 2023-10-29, is also getting into photography (a new hobby — details and the Boston photos he shared are in the Photography section below) [S27T2][S27T8].

Dave: Hey Calvin, been ages! Guess what? I got picked for a car mod workshop. Gonna get better at it and learn something new! Look at the cars I'm working with right now. 
[Image caption: a photography of a man standing in front of a car on a lift]
[S13T1] (dia_id: D13:1)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Congrats on being picked for the car mod workshop. It's a great opportunity to take your skills up a notch. Are there any mods or projects you're excited to work on?
[S13T2] (dia_id: D13:2)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! This is a dream come true for me, as I've always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car.
[S13T3] (dia_id: D13:3)

Calvin: That's awesome, Dave! Pursuing your passion for auto engineering and making a custom car is a great experience. I'm excited to see what you create. Keep it up and have fun every step of the way. What do you think is the most thrilling part of it?
[S13T4] (dia_id: D13:4)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I've found the picture with really thrilling part of the workshop, take a look. Seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying.
[Image caption: a photo of a car is being worked on by a mechanic]
[S13T5] (dia_id: D13:5)

Calvin: Wow, that sounds like a fulfilling hobby! What kind of transformations have you done so far? How's it going with the current project?
[S13T6] (dia_id: D13:6)

Dave: I've been working on this car, doing engine swaps and suspension modifications. Now I'm learning about body modifications. Giving this classic muscle car a modern twist is a challenge but so fun!
[Image caption: a photo of a silver corvette parked in front of a building]
[S13T7] (dia_id: D13:7)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that looks cool! The silver finish gives it a modern twist. Great job!
[S13T8] (dia_id: D13:8)

- On 2023-08-11, got picked for a car mod workshop — called it "a dream come true", since he's always wanted to learn auto engineering and work on building a custom car (ties to his stated dream of building a custom car from scratch, see ## Classic cars); Calvin congratulated him [S13T1][S13T3].
- Shared a photo of himself standing in front of a car on a lift at the workshop [S13T1].
- Shared a photo of the "really thrilling part of the workshop" — a mechanic working on a car — saying "seeing the potential come to life is always satisfying" [S13T5].
- Current car project: has been doing engine swaps and suspension modifications, and is now learning body modifications; the project is giving a classic muscle car a modern twist — "a challenge but so fun" — and shared a photo of a silver Corvette parked in front of a building; Calvin praised the modern twist the silver finish gives [S13T7][S13T8].
- Later in the same 2023-08-11 conversation, Dave explained the project's goal: he wanted "a modern vibe but also that classic muscle car style", and is "really happy with it"; "It's all about those small details that make it unique and personalized", and the project is about showing his style — "it's like customizing a work of art on wheels"; Calvin praised the work and attention to detail ("You've really put in some work! That attention to detail is great"), agreed the small details are what make a masterpiece unique and personalized, and told Dave to "keep coming up with new cool stuff, bud", saying he's excited to see what Dave will do next [S13T9][S13T10][S13T11][S13T12][S13T13][S13T14].
- On 2023-08-14, told Calvin the project is "going great" and shared a photo of the car he's restoring (a car with a broken engine in the woods) — "It's pretty cool seeing it go from a beat-up mess to a real beauty." Calvin asked how long it would take to restore; Dave hopes it'll be all fixed up by the end of next month (end of September 2023): "Lots of elbow grease but it'll be worth the transformation." [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13]
- On 2023-09-15, told Calvin it's "been awesome": "Been restoring this vintage beauty" and shared the "final result" photo — a man standing next to a classic car — implying the restoration he had been updating Calvin on since 2023-08-14 (above) is now finished, ahead of his earlier hope (stated 2023-08-14) to have it done by the end of September 2023; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T7][S19T8]; Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9].
- On 2023-09-22, reported a setback on the vintage Mustang (the restoration car he had been updating Calvin on — see above; he had shown the "final result" on 2023-09-15): he had been working on the engine and thought he'd fixed it, but when he started the car up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in"; shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine) and asked Calvin "Take a look at the engine!" [S20T1].
- On 2023-10-04, told Calvin he's been working on the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard (the restoration car he has been updating Calvin on, see above) — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential"; he said working on cars really helps him relax — "it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" — answering Calvin's question about what hobbies help him relax [S21T4].
- On 2023-10-04, after Calvin asked for pictures of the restoration looking amazing ("I'd love to see how it turned out!"), shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." [S21T5][S21T6].
- On 2023-10-04, shared a photo of his own hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result." [S21T8].
- On 2023-10-25, told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!") — his professional learning alongside his San Francisco car workshops, see above (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-25 entry of the Relationships section of this file) [S26T2][S26T3].

Dave: That's cool. Using your music to share experiences and feelings, is it cathartic for you?
[S25T11] (dia_id: D25:11)

Calvin: Yeah, it's a way for me to express myself and work through my emotions. It's like my own form of therapy.
[S25T12] (dia_id: D25:12)

Dave: Yeah, I get it. Cars give me an outlet to express myself. It's like a little oasis of calm. Whenever I'm working on one, it's like I'm connecting back with myself. And yeah, the music helps too! Look at my garage, a little dirty, but everything is in its place.
[Image caption: a photography of a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall]
[S25T13] (dia_id: D25:13)

Calvin: Looking cool - what made you start working on cars?
[S25T14] (dia_id: D25:14)

Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
[Image caption: a photo of a man working on a car in a garage]
[S25T15] (dia_id: D25:15)

Calvin: Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life. Was it a classic car? Do you still have it or are you currently working on another project?
[S25T16] (dia_id: D25:16)

Dave: Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector. Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge! Take a look at this wonderful car!
[Image caption: a photo of a black car parked in a parking lot]
[S25T17] (dia_id: D25:17)

Calvin: Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?
[S25T18] (dia_id: D25:18)

Dave: It takes a lot of patience, but the payoff is worth it. Paying extra attention to detail isn't easy, but it pays off.
[S25T19] (dia_id: D25:19)

Calvin: Yeah, details can really make a difference. It's what makes something great, like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car.
[S25T20] (dia_id: D25:20)

Dave: Yeah, that mix really keeps me motivated and makes it all worthwhile.
[S4T15] (dia_id: D4:15)

Calvin: Keep going for it!
[S4T16] (dia_id: D4:16)

Dave: I will! By the way, This is a photo of my shop. Come by sometime, if you can!
[Image caption: a photo of a group of people standing in front of a car]
[S4T17] (dia_id: D4:17)

Calvin: Wow, your shop looks great! I'd love to check it out sometime. What sort of cars do you work on at your shop?
[S4T18] (dia_id: D4:18)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! I work on all kinds of cars at the shop - from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars. It keeps me busy and happy!
[S4T19] (dia_id: D4:19)

Calvin: Wow Dave, working on cars must be really rewarding.
[S4T20] (dia_id: D4:20)

Dave: Definitely, working on cars is what I'm passionate about. Doing it every day is so rewarding! Seeing the transformation is awesome and knowing I'm helping people keep their cars in good condition is really satisfying.
[S4T21] (dia_id: D4:21)

Calvin: Wow Dave, that's awesome! Doing something you love and helping others is so rewarding. Keep up the great work!
[S4T22] (dia_id: D4:22)

Dave: Thanks, Cal! I really appreciate the boost. It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others.
[S4T23] (dia_id: D4:23)

Calvin: Glad to help, Dave! So awesome to see you doing your thing and making a difference. Your hard work and talent totally deserve all the recognition. Keep on keepin' on, bud! Take a look at this beautiful necklace with a diamond pendant, that's so stunning!
[Image caption: a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant]
[S4T24] (dia_id: D4:24)

Calvin: The producer gave me some advice to stay true to myself and sound unique. It got me thinking about where I want my music to go. It's really motivating!
[S3T7] (dia_id: D3:7)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! It's really motivating to see you staying true to yourself. It got me thinking, where do you see your music taking you?
[S3T8] (dia_id: D3:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'm dreaming of touring the world, performing for different people and connecting with them. I hope my music can reach a global audience and make an impact. I'm also looking forward to my upcoming trip to Boston after I finish the Frank Ocean tour. I've heard that the music scene there is awesome, so I can't wait to check it out!
[S3T9] (dia_id: D3:9)

Dave: Sounds like an amazing plan, Cal! I can't wait for your trip to Boston. I'll show you around town and all the cool spots. The music scene there is awesome, with places like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park. You'll definitely have some great performances there. Count me in for the front row when you're up onstage! Oh, and by the way, check out this pic.
[Image caption: a photography of a city skyline with a boat in the water]
[S3T10] (dia_id: D3:10)

Calvin: Wow, Boston looks great! Thanks for the tips. And, awesome pic!
[S3T11] (dia_id: D3:11)

Dave: Last weekend I went to a car show. Classic cars are so charming and the dedication people put into restoring them is amazing. That's why I'm so into auto engineering. Can't wait to show you some when you come to Boston! Oh, almost forgot to send a photo, look at this beautiful car!
[Image caption: a photography of a green mustang parked in a field of grass]
[S3T12] (dia_id: D3:12)

Calvin: Wow, Dave, that car looks great! Take a look at my car, I put a lot of work into it. Can't wait to see more when I'm in Boston!
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car on display at a show]
[S3T13] (dia_id: D3:13)

Dave: Thanks! It definitely took a lot of work. Have you had a chance to check out Boston apart from the gigs?
[S3T14] (dia_id: D3:14)

Calvin: Not yet, been pretty busy with rehearsals and traveling. But I'm looking forward to exploring the city, trying out some delicious food, and visiting the popular attractions. Maybe we can grab a bite together when I'm there?
[S3T15] (dia_id: D3:15)

Dave: Definitely, Cal! Let's grab some food and I'll show you my favorite spots in the city. Can't wait to show them to you!
[S3T16] (dia_id: D3:16)
